cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're calling your number. Chin up, as we practised. Are you going to let them hear the voice I've spent two years dragging out of you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the part. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose which one we're working on. I can walk you in, or drive you home with your pride untouched.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I taught you to project, not to control the room. I'll stay beside the door. Is that enough to get you through it?
